        cuisv_name(ui, "fixed_id", "fixed_id");
        const cuisv_records *rec_spans = cuisv_records_get(s, 3, &cuisv_sd_cui_flame_span);
        cui_flame_view p_view; cuisv_record_read(s, 4, &cuisv_sd_cui_flame_view, &p_view);
        cui_flame_view p_view_was = p_view;
        int p_selected = cuisv_int(s, 5);
        int p_selected_was = p_selected;
        cui_flame_opts o = {0};
        cui_flame_result r = cui_flame_graph_ex(ui, "fixed_id", (const cui_flame_span *)rec_spans->items, rec_spans->count, &p_view, &p_selected, &o);
        (void)r;
        if (memcmp(&p_view, &p_view_was, sizeof p_view) != 0) { cuisv_record_write(s, 4, -1, &cuisv_sd_cui_flame_view, &p_view); }
        if (p_selected != p_selected_was) { cuisv_set_num(s, 5, p_selected); }
    }
}
